While in Vash Naroom, the kids discover that Gorgram has offered a challenge to his Shadow Magi: whoever gets Orwin's Staff, becomes his second-in-command! Edyn has to use her knowledge of her realm to defeat the eager Shadow Magi.
A young man turns to a witch doctor to lure the woman he loves away from her fiancé, but instead turns her into a zombie slave.

In World War One German officer Reitliger enlists the help of Karnak, a man with supposed psychic powers, to find out how his girlfriend Elsa is faring back in Germany. Seeing a vision of her infidelity he gets Karnak to will him back home.

p.t: One Step Beyond: The Death Waltz
p.d: At a cavalry outpost in 1860s New Mexico, flirtatious, heartless Lillie takes great delight in playing her two beaus, decent Eustace Fairchild and the sexier, more dashing Henry Buchanan off against each other.

It's May in England and a Gypsy fortuneteller and her rakish son set to work rooking a gullible public. But when the phony fortuneteller actually receives the gift of clairvoyance she has long prayed for, she is startled by what she sees.
Following the Second World War German ex-prisoner of war Carl Bremer remains in London, working on bomb disposal units. He marries a local woman and she is about to give birth to their child.

p.t: One Step Beyond: The Room Upstairs
p.d: Will and Esther Hollis, a childless American couple, rent an old house in London. Esther is convinced she can hear a child crying though nobody else can. She locates the cries to an upstairs room, which she enters.

Standing on a soap box, Harvey Lawrence proclaims that he killed a man. A flashback reveals that when he was an up-and-coming lawyer prosecuting a man for murder, he deliberately allowed the man to hang.
A teenage boy must deal with his mother's complicated response after his father temporarily abandons them to take a menial and dangerous job.

Molly Gunn is the daughter of a late rock legend, and the toast of New York City. But when her inheritance is stolen, Molly is forced to do something she's never done before - get a job. Molly becomes a nanny to a girl, who is eight going on forty.
After returning home for her mother's funeral, a young woman is terrorized by visions from her past. A musician finds a suicide note that reveals the dark history of his new house.
A malicious child predator enters Jackee's home and she is rescued by her guardian angel. After a performance, Louie Anderson is visited by the ghost of his mother who had suddenly passed.
Tom Arnold takes his teenage anger out on a pipe organ, angering a revengeful spirit; Dee Snider's murdered brother-in-law has a message from the grave.
A protective spirit saves Brett Butler from an abusive relationship; a murdered man threatens Cassandra Peterson's life in her own home; lonely spirits stalk Phil Varone.
A small room in Laura Prepon's new home leaves her feeling very uneasy; a young Vince Neil hears mysterious noises coming from his bedroom closet.

Vicki Butler-Henderson is in Italy testing the most powerful Ferrari ever made, the brand new 730bhp F12berlinetta, to the limit. Tiff and Jason are at the track with the two cheapest hot hatches on sale – the Suzuki Swift and Renault Sport Twingo.

Vicki goes behind the scenes of famous Italian car designers Pininfarina – the people who have shaped every single Ferrari of the last 50 years. Tiff is joined by British rally star Mark Higgins in a test of two new SUVs with supercar power figures
Tiff is joined by German motoring legend and 'Queen of the Nurburgring' Sabine Schmitz for a head to head battle between our two favourite sports cars of the last year – the BMW M6 and Porsche 911.

Jason Plato and Tiff Needell hold a high octane track test of three brand new super glamorous convertibles from Audi, Maserati and Mercedes. Vicki Butler-Henderson races wheel to wheel with World Superbike hotshot Chaz Davies
Adrianna Vertison uncovers her man making moves on another woman. Follow up with Courtney Whitehall.
Sketch helps Sian cover a clown tattoo that's scaring the life out of anyone who sees it. Jay has to deal with Emma's extremely intimate cat portrait. Daz needs assistance covering a boastful tattoo.
Alice gets her claws into dog-lover William's cover when he betrays his furry friends in ink. Emma disguises her tattooed equations after attempts to impress her maths teacher didn't add up.
Love is in the air as Glen rids Riley of her Valentine's issues, Jay fixes Leon's bedroom problems, Alice works on Suzanne's cocky Cupid, and Sketch divorces Jordan from his tattoo.

p.t: Count Duckula: Around the World in a Total Daze
p.d: Von Goosewing challenges Duckula to a race around the world.

While vacationing in the canals of Venice, Danger Mouse and Penfold bump into a highway undergoing construction, being built by Baron Greenback, who holds a document that allows him to construct whatever he wants.

Bill and Ted travel through time to find a truly big dude who will beat up Deacon's bully. Because of a minor malfunction with the phone booth, they end up in New England in 1773. There they serve as the impetus for the American Revolution.

Pinky in Paradise': Aided by a Parrot, Pinky searches for buried treasure only to come up against a Voodoo Man. 'Department Story Pink-erton': Pinky gets a security job at a department store and must contend with the notorious 'Whistler.'
Count Duckula is approached to perform as a prince in a Hollywood film.

'Trains, Pains and Panthers': Rushing to a job interview, The Panther takes the Hover Train, but runs into the Dogfather and his gang. 'Wet and Wild Pinky': To be promoted to Lifeguard, Pink must baby-sit the boss' precocious niece.

Greenback harvests Mexico's saguaro cacti and uses them to fill the seat cushions of Britain's leaders, as well as Colonel K's and Danger Mouse's seats. Danger Mouse and Penfold travel to the Chihuahuan Desert to try to stop him

p.t: Super Mario Brothers Super Show: Mario and the Beanstalk
p.d: Desperate for cash, the Marios trade the royal cow for bean seeds. Princess scolds them, and accidentally sneezes, blowing the beans into the yard.

p.t: New Twilight Zone: Little Boy Lost/Wish Bank/Nightcrawlers
p.d: Photographer faces dilemma And encounters familiar boy/Janice gets lamp with wish restrictions/Trooper's diner stop unveils vet's nightmares.

p.t: A Century of Science Fiction: After the End
p.d: What things to come will there be after man destroys himself and the world? Examine the end of the world through this passel of post-apocalyptic pictures.

p.t: A Century of Science Fiction: Alien Life Forms
p.d: We are not alone. Not by a long shot. We're surrounded by sci-fi flicks filled with strange visitors from other planets with powers and abilities far beyond those of mortal men.

Percy emerges from hyperspace without Dante or Luc to discover that 15 years have passed. When Percy tries to take legal possession of the Trans-Utopian, she runs into conflict with a starhunter, who is revealed as her cousin Travis, now much older.

Travis and Callie are hired by the Jup-Fed to arrest Dakkota 79, a Raider leader on the verge of starting a war with the Verran Clan. Rudolfo's inquiry into a possible bounty on Travis leads to complications with his new crewmates.

When snorkel-nosed furry aliens arrive on Earth, they’ll encounter a foggy wilderness filled with sociopathic poachers, bizarre bursts of violence and pathos, and the boy who befriends a blue-eyed extraterrestrial he names ‘Trumpy’.
The first manned flight to Mars is a flop, so a space official (Hal Holbrook) fakes it Hollywood-style for the public.
Explore traits we once thought were uniquely ours- language, tool-making, even laughter- to uncover their evolutionary roots.

p.t: scienceNOW: How Smart Can We Get?
p.d: How Smart Can We Get? How do you get a genius brain? Is it all in the genes? Or is it hard work? Episodes include: Einstein's Brain; Mystery of the Savant Brain; What is Intelligence?; and Profile: Sian Beilock.

Terrorists target airliners, exploiting security gaps with bombs in drinks, shoes, and more. Air Crash Confidential explores this cat-and-mouse game with evolving threats and countermeasures like metal detectors, body scanners, and vigilant officers.

Aircraft collisions are among the deadliest accidents.Despite millions spent on solutions, new issues arise. Key incidents and stories from survivors and a grieving father who took revenge after losing his family highlight why these problems persist.

p.t: Sherlock Holmes: The Case of the Baker Street Bachelors
p.d: A political leader is being blackmailed, and to find the blackmailers, Holmes and Watson join a marriage bureau. However, things don't go quite as planned, and Holmes winds up getting arrested and thrown in jail.
Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson treat an injured man after a fierce encounter that he barely escapes.

p.t: Sherlock Holmes: The Case of the Haunted Gainsborough
p.d: Malcolm MacGregan will lose his family's Scottish castle if he can't make the mortgage payment, by midnight.
When a valuable pearl with a sinister reputation is stolen, Sherlock Holmes must investigate its link to a series of brutal murders.

p.t: Sherlock Holmes: The Case of the Royal Murder
p.d: As payment for solving a case, Holmes and Watson are invited to spend a weekend at an estate in the Balkans.
Martin tries to be less boring to win back Clare.

When Stuart’s favorite restaurant is about to close, he takes Phil along for one last meal, only to bump into Phil’s ex-wife who is now engaged. Holly is baffled by mixed signals from a cute co-worker. Haskell starts an online traffic school.

Phil (Donald Faison) meets a foreign lingerie model who doesn’t speak English and Stuart (David Alan Basche) has to act as interpreter. Eden helps Holly overcome a bad first impression with a handsome neighbor. Haskell buys a coffin as an investment.

Phil (Donald Faison), Stuart (David Alan Basche), and Haskell (Wayne Knight) are forced to trade apartments with Holly (Kristen Johnston) when her mother (Judith Light) comes for a visit because Holly never told her mother her engagement ended months ago.
When Holly (Kristen Johnston) has to face her cheating ex fiancé for the first time since they broke up, she enlists the guys' help to prove to him he lost the best thing he ever had.

Phil (Donald Faison) is nervous when Holly (Kristen Johnston) starts dating his top client – basketball player Kevin Tyler (Amar'e Stoudemire). Haskell (Wayne Knight) lures Stuart (David Alan Basche) into the world of sports betting.
A twisted tale of childhood revenge.

Beyond Earth Orbit - The Apollo program takes bold new steps. IXV Re-entry Vehicle - Europe is working to perfect a re-entry vehicle. Galileo Satellites Lost and Found - Navigation satellites go into incorrect orbit.

Project Gemini Commences - Did Gemini give the US a lead in the space race? Venus Express - The last days of ESA's Venus probe. EMU - NASA's Extravehicular Mobility Unit. Deep Space Communications - ESA's worldwide network of giant dishes.

Project Gemini Advances - NASA refines the techniques needed for rendezvous. Cassini at Saturn - In the Cassini probe's final years of activity, its handlers are asking it to do more complex and risky assignments.

Cold War And The Start of the Space Race - Cold War rivalry and the acceleration of space exploration. Servicing Hubble - Preparations for Hubble's final servicing mission. Chasing a Comet - Launch and the difficult path to rendezvous.

Rebuilding Project Apollo - After the Apollo 1 disaster NASA resumes manned space flight. Orbiting Carbon Observatory 2 - Monitoring the Earth's Co2 levels in unprecedented detail. Zero Gravity Training - Parabolic flights.

Project Mercury Advances - America's first manned space program finally puts a man in orbit. Camera Tracking - The array of special cameras that follow a spacecraft at launch. The International Space Station - The building and operation.

The Beginning of the End - After the first Moon landing the Apollo science program was about to start in earnest but people were losing interest. Apollo Gets Complicated - New technology is added that extends the reach of the Apollo program.

In steamy New Orleans, a police detective doesn't know whether to arrest his prime suspect or make love to her after he unexpectedly finds himself in a passionate affair with an accused killer.
Suspecting her husband of having an affair, a woman trails him to the house he's been renovating only to discover that he's dead. As the investigation unfolds, things are not what they seem.

When a deadly fire destroys a northern outpost a week before Christmas, Buffalo puts everything aside to come to the rescue. Cargo Manager Kelly receives a shocking diagnosis that renews her fight to quit smoking.

On a two-man build in Alberta, Joel and his right-hand man Shawn are challenged by broken logs and stubborn headers.
Sheep-hating Rowdy Yates convinces a band of belligerent sheepherders that it's better to talk than fight.
Wishbone is sent to guide a trouble-ridden circus train to a nearby town after the circus' lion nearly panics Gil Favor's herd.
A dedicated scientist causes a near mutiny on the Gil Favor drive when he tries to stock the Sacramento River with shad.
Gil Favor's drovers are delighted when a beautiful actress staggers into their camp -- until they learn she was once a Yankee spy.

p.d: An urn commissioned in a Cambodian monastery by the Chinese emperor for the remains of Confucius is about to be destroyed by systematic bombing of a whole province.

Sydney and Nigel travel to Istanbul to investigate the death of one Sydney's friends, a professor who was trying to prove Hercules did exist by finding the Belt of Hippolyte.
When Nigel is charmed by brilliant student Lorraine to show her their offices (and kiss), a burglar knocks out Sidney, but what was robbed?

Jeremy Wade is in New Zealand on the trail of a man-eater, to determine if it is a mere legend, or the same creature that has attacked divers, seized a child, and devoured sheep alive.
Biologist and extreme angler Jeremy Wade travels to Germany where he meets modern-day victims of a beast that has been on the prowl in these waters for the past 700 years.

On the tropical island of Sulawesi, Indonesia, a tourist snorkeller and several local fishermen have been killed and injured by a mysterious sea creature that impales its victims. Wade travels to the scene to investigate.
Jeremy Wade homes in on a predator now invading America's backyards. Said to breathe air and crawl on land, the snakehead is rumoured to be able to kill a human.
